title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: this is the 'équation des lacets' cycle, Grothendieck's study of the profinite free product Z/2 * Z/3 (completion of PSL2(Z)) with generators σ (order 2) and ρ (order 3), and of the groups that act on it. It is the setting that leads to Grothendieck–Teichmüller-type groups.

The ambient group G_{ρ,σ} has the following structure:
- characters ε_2, ε_3 with values in μ = {±1};
- a cyclotomic-type character χ;
- a normal subgroup 𝔊 with quotient γ_{ρ,σ};
- an index-2 subgroup 𝔊^+ of 𝔊 (1 → 𝔊^+ → 𝔊 → μ_2 → 1).

The previous page defines, inside G_{ρ,σ}:
- N_ρ = {a : a(ρ) = ρ^{±1}} and N_σ likewise, i.e. 'normalisers' of the local generators;
- Z_ρ, Z_σ, their centralisers, given as kernels of ε_3 and ε_2;
- SZ_ρ, SZ_σ, the intersections with 𝔊^+ (and SN = SZ).
It also gives exact sequences 1 → Z_ρ → N_ρ → μ → 1, split by the involution τ', for which ε_2(τ') = ε_3(τ') = χ(τ') = -1.

This page organises these subgroups into a lattice of inclusions.

(58), a first sketch:
- D_{τ1} = μ_{τ1} × μ is a Klein-four-type group generated by the involution τ1 and the centre/sign μ.
- It sits in two 'dihedral' groups D_ρ and D_σ.
- These map to N_ρ ∩ 𝔊 = μ_{τ1}·SZ_ρ and N_σ ∩ 𝔊 = μ_{τ1}·SZ_σ, which in turn sit in 𝔊 and in N_ρ, N_σ, all inside G_{ρ,σ}.

(59), 'ou mieux', a fuller cube-like Hasse diagram of finite and profinite subgroups:
- The bottom finite part is 1 ⊂ μ, μ_{τ1} ⊂ D_{τ1}.
- The labels 2 and 3 on the arrows D_{τ1} → D_σ, μ → L_σ, D_{τ1} → D_ρ, μ → L_ρ plausibly indicate indices: the extensions by σ (index 2) and by ρ (index 3).
- So L_ρ and L_σ are the finite groups generated by μ and the stabilising local generator, and D_ρ, D_σ are their dihedral enlargements by τ1.
- These map into SN_ρ, SN_σ, SZ_ρ, SZ_σ, then into N_ρ, N_σ, Z_ρ, Z_σ and 𝔊^+ ⊂ 𝔊.
- Further maps go to the auxiliary groups G'_{ρ,σ} and G''_{ρ,σ} (stabilisers related to the characters ε_3 and ε_2) and finally to G_{ρ,σ}.

(60) defines superscripted versions N^𝔖_ρ, N^𝔖_σ, Z^𝔖, SZ^𝔖, as intersections with a subgroup G^𝔖_{ρ,σ}. By the next page, G^𝔖_{ρ,σ} is an extension 1 → 𝔊^𝔖 → G^𝔖_{ρ,σ} → γ_{ρ,σ} → 1, i.e. a 'restricted' version of the main group.

(61) asserts exact sequences 1 → SZ^𝔖_ρ → N^𝔖_ρ → γ_{ρ,σ} → 1, and the same for σ. In words, the stabiliser of the local generator ρ (resp. σ), up to inversion, surjects onto the full outer quotient γ_{ρ,σ}. Every outer class can therefore be normalised to fix ρ (resp. σ) up to inverse, with kernel the 'special centraliser'.

This is the analogue of the fact that Galois/GT elements can be chosen to stabilise the inertia/stabiliser subgroups at the elliptic points of orders 3 and 2, i.e. decomposition-group-type exact sequences at the two 'local' points. The next page compares these sequences with the unrestricted ones and with the sign characters ε_2, ε_3.
errors: Not verifiable from the page alone; the definition of the restricted group G^𝔖 is not on this page.

In (59), the same label Z_σ appears to be used for two distinct nodes: the one mapping to G''_{ρ,σ} and the lower one receiving SZ_ρ and mapping to G'_{ρ,σ}. The lower one should presumably be Z_ρ. This is a slip of notation.
(58) and (59) are exploratory sketches (dashed arrows from 𝔊^+ to G', G'', several unclear arrows), not a verified lattice.

ideas.what: Lattice of normalisers/centralisers of the local generators ρ (order 3) and σ (order 2) of the profinite completion of Z/2*Z/3 inside an automorphism group, together with finite dihedral/Klein subgroups.
ideas.modern_name: Local stabiliser (decomposition/inertia-type) subgroups at elliptic points for GT-type actions on the profinite completion of PSL2(Z)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Drinfeld, Ihara; Lochak–Schneps; Harbater–Schneps; Nakamura (normalisers and inertia in GT)
ideas.where_published: Only the general programme is in Esquisse d'un programme (1984); this lattice is not.

ideas.what: Exact sequences 1 → SZ_ρ → N_ρ → γ → 1: the local stabiliser surjects onto the outer quotient.
ideas.modern_name: Surjectivity of normaliser onto the outer group / existence of 'normalised' representatives (cf. tangential base points at elliptic points)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Analogous statements in the GT literature (Lochak–Schneps, Nakamura, Hoshi–Minamide–Mochizuki on combinatorial anabelian geometry)

missed.claim: A systematic Hasse diagram of finite (Klein, dihedral) subgroups and local normaliser/centraliser subgroups of the automorphism group of the profinite modular group, with paired exact sequences at the order-2 and order-3 points. It is a structural bookkeeping device; similar data exist piecemeal in the literature, but the unified diagram does not.
missed.quote: On a des suites exactes 1 → SZ_ρ → N_ρ → γ_{ρ,σ} → 1
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Minor. It could serve as an organising template for the local structure of GT-like groups acting on profinite PSL2(Z) at the elliptic points, but the content appears close to known material.

deep.surprise_reason: Careful structural bookkeeping in a context (GT-type groups acting on profinite Z/2*Z/3) whose general ideas are known. The page holds no evident new theorem, only diagrams of inclusions and standard-looking exact sequences.
transcription_corrections: The superscript in (60)-(61) is the same symbol rendered 𝔖 on the next page, not ♮. It should be transcribed consistently.
In (61) the target is γ_{ρ,σ} (lowercase gamma, as on the next page), not Γ_{ρ,σ}.

In (59) the 'c' marks after node names are hook-arrow tails (inclusions). 'SN_ρ ∩ SZ_σ' is actually two separate nodes, SN_ρ and SZ_σ, written side by side; likewise 'N_ρ → Z_σ' denotes separate nodes N_ρ and Z_σ.
In (59) the lower-right node reading Z_σ (between SZ_ρ and G'_{ρ,σ}) is probably meant as Z_ρ.
In (58) the top-right node is N_ρ (with a crossed-out arrow), and 𝔊 → G_{ρ,σ} is drawn with a thick arrow.

Before (59): 'ou mieux'. Before (60): 'On définit :'. In (60): 'intersections de N_ρ, N_σ etc avec G^𝔖_{ρ,σ}'. Before (61): 'On a des suites exactes'. Last line: 'et des [diagrammes?] de suites exactes'.
